output_frames: T' = floor((T - 1) / 2) + 1 for T input rows ([1, T, 160])
text_script: Quran Phonetic Script (quran_transcript; compare with quran_phonetizer(uthmani, moshaf, remove_spaces=True).phonemes), one character per token, no spaces
not_in_any_head: vocab.json ids 43-45 (<s>, </s>, <unk>) are tokenizer added tokens; the phonemes head has 43 outputs (0..42), so they never occur.
greedy_decode: Take the `phonemes` logits [T', 43] (batch 1). softmax is only needed for confidences; argmax(logits) == argmax(softmax).
a[t] = argmax_v logits[t, v] for every frame t (ties: lowest id, as numpy/torch).

Split a[0..T'-1] into maximal runs of equal ids. Each run whose id != 0 (blank, '[PAD]') emits exactly ONE token; blank runs emit nothing. Output text = concatenation of id_to_text of the emitted tokens, in order, no separators (the phonetic script has no spaces).
Confidence of a token (quran_muaalem Unit.probs) = mean over the frames of its run of max_v softmax(logits[t])[v].

Repeated characters: equal ids in consecutive frames always merge, so a run of the same character in the text (madd 'اااا' / 'ۥۥ' / 'ۦۦۦۦ', ghunna 'نننن' / 'مممم', a doubled consonant 'لل') can only come from separate runs of that id split by >= 1 blank frame, e.g. frames [ن ن 0 ن 0 0 ن ن] -> 'ننن'. One run = one character regardless of how many frames it lasts; frame-run lengths carry no meaning. This is how the model was trained: Wav2Vec2CTCTokenizer splits the target string into single characters and CTC needs a blank between two equal labels.

quran_muaalem.decode.ctc_decode (used for the torch reference) has one deviation: when the LAST frame is non-blank and the frame before it is blank, that last token is dropped (the source says '# BUG: trailing zero id at the end'). The app rule above does not copy this; it matters only for clips ending mid-phoneme (see README parity numbers).
sifat_note: The 10 sifat heads are greedy-CTC decoded the same way, but quran_muaalem then aligns each sifa sequence to the phoneme groups (quran_transcript.chunck_phonemes) of the predicted and the REFERENCE phonetic script (multilevel_greedy_decode); that alignment needs the reference text and is not part of this export.
